about: compiler/testwait: deadline report-share reservation, clamped wait Left duration, exponential poll backoff, and WaitTable SoA (SELFHOST-TASK-PROFMD-SIZES).

mutants.name: selfhost-testwait-end-reserves-share
mutants.from:
let share = if tenth < ReportShare { tenth } else { ReportShare }
	option.Some[time.Time]{Value: dl.Add(-share)}
mutants.rule: End must subtract at most ReportShare from deadline so reports flush before test timeout.

mutants.name: selfhost-testwait-left-clamps-minleft
mutants.from: if d > MinLeft { d } else { MinLeft }
mutants.to: if true || d > MinLeft { d } else { MinLeft }
mutants.rule: Left must clamp positive deadline remainders to at least MinLeft.

mutants.name: selfhost-testwait-nextpoll-caps-lastpoll
mutants.rule: NextPoll must cap doubled intervals at LastPoll.
